quote: We formulate semantic change detection as an anomaly detection task in the evolution of pretrained word embeddings.

Model performance is assessed via rank-based metrics . ... The level of semantic change of a word is then calculated via the average cosine similarity between the actual and the predicted word representations through time ... We employ ... recall at k (Rec@k, k=5%, 10%, 50%) as our evaluation metrics.
For evaluation, similarly to , we employ the average rank across all of the semantically changed words (in %, denoted here as µr), with lower scores indicating a better model.
